detailed_descriptions.en: The original Plague Inc: Evolved soundtrack, featuring all of the tracks from Plague Inc: Evolved as well as the music from the original Plague Inc. game - including the haunting main theme, the paranoid notes of Neurax worm mind control and the aggressive style of the zombie-producing Necroa virus (plus a surprise bonus track!). We will be adding more music to the game in future - this will be added to the soundtrack and available for no extra cost if you've already purchased it. Includes 11-track album and bonus track in MP3 format. *Updated - "Flatten the Curve" added 11/2020* *Updated - "Void Tectonics" added 04/2026*

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The original Plague Inc: Evolved soundtrack, featuring all of the tracks from Plague Inc: Evolved as well as the music from the original Plague Inc. game - including the haunting main theme, the paranoid notes of Neurax worm mind control and the aggressive style of the zombie-producing Necroa virus (plus a surprise bonus track!).

We will be adding more music to the game in future - this will be added to the soundtrack and available for no extra cost if you've already purchased it.

Includes 11-track album and bonus track in MP3 format.

*Updated - "Flatten the Curve" added 11/2020*

*Updated - "Void Tectonics" added 04/2026*
